rules.statement: Translate the approved control-valve arc — core suspended, precision nested, body encloses, assembly complete, product presence — into one fixed-duration grey-model Animatic without changing its thesis, order, product-state handoffs or truth constraints.

children.statement: Acceptance must prove that the camera previs and rendered Animatic use the five approved IDs in order, cover the complete timeline and preserve the released copy and cognitive purpose.
Acceptance must prove a canonical fixed-duration forward playback exists independently of scroll control and ends with a motionless final fifteen-percent hero hold.

rules.statement: Author exactly one deterministic state for every canonical Animatic frame, including camera position, target, roll, field of view, focus distance, product and trim-layer transforms, body opacity, light state, shot identity and transition occlusion.

children.statement: Acceptance must reject missing, duplicate or unordered frames, timeline gaps, non-finite states, roll, blackout, teleporting or drift in comprehension holds.

rules.statement: Use the actual decoded CASCADE_TRIM geometry to determine whether the current shot asset can expose four independently transformable connected geometry islands corresponding collectively to the three named cages and seat. Lighting-only stage changes do not count as separation.

children.statement: Acceptance must record exactly four non-empty connected geometry islands from CASCADE_TRIM, expose their independent transforms and show staged axis-aligned separation in rendered evidence.
Acceptance must describe island numbering as camera-readable geometric order unless individual source-label identity is independently proven; it must not invent manufacturing or maintenance order.

rules.statement: Validate the body-enclosure beat against the real model: the completed core must remain screen-visible while body opacity and closure progress establish its location, then may become physically enclosed without a blackout or hidden camera relocation.

children.statement: Acceptance must sample the closure interval and prove a bounded opacity progression, persistent core visibility before final enclosure, zero full-frame occlusion and a stable camera axis.

rules.statement: Validate the same central mechanical axis and deterministic product pose during canonical forward playback, canonical reverse playback and forward-back-forward scrubbing.

children.statement: Acceptance must observe all five beat IDs in forward order and exact reverse order without blackout, missing beat or camera teleport.
Acceptance must compare repeated samples at the same normalized progress and prove camera, focus, body and independently controlled part transforms reproduce without drift.

rules.statement: Bind the Animatic to the supplied STEP product tree and observed GLB geometry. Visual decomposition, opacity and authored paths are commercial camera methods; unsupported performance, certification, flow, failure-direction, manufacturing and maintenance claims remain prohibited.

children.statement: Acceptance must preserve the script truth constraints in visible copy, metadata and evidence.

rules.statement: Increase the Animatic from restrained engineering motion to clearly legible commercial choreography: the trim layers must use materially larger axis-aligned travel, the camera must change distance and observation angle across the five beats, and part, camera, product-yaw and lighting actions must hand off in authored intervals instead of drifting uniformly.

children.statement: Acceptance must quantify a larger trim separation span, non-trivial camera path length, multi-angle product yaw and actuator seating travel while keeping every per-frame camera and target step within comfort bounds.

Acceptance must prove multiple intervals in which camera motion and a meaningful product-state change occur together, separated by authored comprehension holds, with exact deterministic reverse playback.

rules.statement: Derive a browser-scrubbable video experiment from the approved 540-frame control-valve Animatic without changing its five-beat edit, product state, camera, light, timing or truth boundaries.

children.statement: Acceptance must prove exactly 540 UI-free product frames at 30 fps are rendered from the same deterministic state sampler and preserve the first, beat-boundary and hero states.
Acceptance must prove page copy, chapter state and controls remain HTML/CSS overlays rather than being permanently baked into the product video.

rules.statement: Promote the verified control-valve scroll-video route into a visitor-facing, Pages-compatible product story. It must use the selected GOP 6 video and static first-frame fallback to explain the observed product structure without exposing experimental instrumentation, inventing product claims, collecting user data, or making universal performance promises.

children.statement: Acceptance must prove that the route gives visitors a clear product narrative, a real catalog destination, semantic content, and no visitor-facing GOP comparison, engineering telemetry, fake form, fabricated proof, certification, performance, manufacturing or maintenance claims.

Acceptance must prove that the selected GOP 6 media is scroll-seekable with the non-empty static poster visible before video readiness, and that reduced-motion users retain visible product content and a usable catalog action.

Acceptance must prove that the business-page scroll track is 280vh and maps only the motion-bearing first 85 percent of the retained GOP 6 source to visitor scroll progress, so the full product is reached at the end of the track without a terminal hero hold.
